acn_data_protocol.controller_information: At plug-in use the earliest complete declared kWhRequested and requestedDeparture plus observable connection state. Actual disconnectTime is a hidden environment event.
acn_data_protocol.unclaimed_session_policy: Exclude sessions without a complete initial commitment from primary analysis.
acn_data_protocol.target_interpretation: Service ratio is delivered energy divided by user-declared requested energy.

charging_data.station_assignment: deterministic hash of session ID across synthetic stations
charging_data.note: Real JPL ACN sessions are mapped to synthetic feeder stations.

solar_data.note: Nearby regional solar-resource proxy reused for sensitivity only; it is neither measured JPL rooftop PV nor site-specific PV validation.

feeder_sensitivity.note: Synthetic shared-import scarcity, not JPL's measured feeder limit.

v3.selection_status: external-site frozen replication; the controller design and hyperparameters are copied from Caltech without JPL development selection. Only causal JPL train/calibration fitting is permitted.
v3.selection_rule: Copied unchanged from the Caltech September development decision; no JPL result may change the selected policy.
